# UI/UX Revamp

## Specs

```yaml
- title: "UI Design System"
  slug: ui-design-system
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Port imgen's design token architecture into kspec's Tailwind-based web UI.
    Map oklch color tokens, spacing, radii, z-index, typography, and animation
    keyframes as Tailwind theme extensions. Establish consistent visual language
    across all views.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The web UI app.css file
      when: |
        imgen token-contract.css values are mapped as Tailwind @theme inline extensions
      then: |
        All 16 color tokens, 4 radii, 7 spacing, 7 z-index, and 3 font families
        are available as Tailwind utility classes (e.g. bg-design-surface, border-design-border)
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        A component using design tokens
      when: |
        The dark theme tokens are applied
      then: |
        oklch colors render correctly and status colors (pending=amber, in_progress=orange,
        pending_review=blue, needs_work=yellow, completed=emerald, blocked=red, cancelled=gray)
        are visually distinct
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        A view with loading states
      when: |
        Content is loading
      then: |
        Shimmer animation plays on skeleton elements, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        An active agent task card
      when: |
        The agent is working
      then: |
        Breathing/pulse animation plays on the card border, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion

- title: "App Shell and Navigation"
  slug: ui-app-shell
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Restructure the web UI layout with collapsible sidebar navigation, header bar
    with command palette and connection status, and grouped navigation sections.
    Preserve existing functionality during migration.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The web UI loaded in daemon mode
      when: |
        The app shell renders
      then: |
        A collapsible sidebar shows grouped navigation: Work (Dashboard, Tasks, Agents, Sessions),
        Specs (Specs, Plans, Validate), Capture (Inbox, Observations, Triage),
        Config (Workflows, Settings)
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        Sidebar navigation items
      when: |
        Items have actionable counts (inbox items, unresolved observations, pending review tasks)
      then: |
        Badge counts display next to the relevant nav items
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        The /items route
      when: |
        A user navigates to /items
      then: |
        They are redirected to /specs preserving any query parameters
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        The Observations nav item
      when: |
        There are zero unresolved observations
      then: |
        The nav item is still visible (not hidden)

- title: "Task Board (Kanban)"
  slug: ui-task-board
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Kanban-style task board with columns mapping to kspec task states.
    Active Fleet row shows currently running agent work with live output.
    Task cards show key metadata, clicking opens detail modal.
    Not drag-and-drop — tasks transition via agents/CLI.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        Tasks in various states
      when: |
        The task board renders
      then: |
        Tasks are distributed into columns: Backlog (pending, manual_only/unassessed),
        Ready (pending, eligible), In Progress (in_progress, needs_work),
        Review (pending_review), Done (completed recent), with blocked and cancelled
        handled as sections/indicators
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        A task card on the board
      when: |
        The card renders
      then: |
        It shows priority badge, tag chips, title, slug (mono), spec ref link,
        and metadata footer (notes count, dependency count, age)
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        A task card
      when: |
        The user clicks it
      then: |
        A detail modal opens showing full task info: title, description, status,
        priority, type, spec ref, tags, dependencies, blocked-by, notes, todos,
        automation status, VCS info (branch, PR link), plan ref, session link
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        Agents actively working on tasks (dispatch running)
      when: |
        The task board renders
      then: |
        An Active Fleet row appears at the top showing cards with task title,
        agent name, elapsed time with pulse indicator, and last few lines of output
    - id: ac-5
      given: |
        The task board with WebSocket connected
      when: |
        A task state changes
      then: |
        The board updates in real-time without page refresh
    - id: ac-6
      given: |
        The task detail modal in daemon mode
      when: |
        The user clicks action buttons (Start, Submit, Complete, Block, Add Note)
      then: |
        The corresponding task transition or mutation is executed via API

- title: "Session Stream View"
  slug: ui-session-stream
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    View for watching agent work — both historical and live. Renders structured
    session events (messages, tool calls, thinking blocks) from events.jsonl.
    Live sessions show streaming text with periodic structured refresh.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        A completed session with events.jsonl
      when: |
        The user navigates to /sessions/:id
      then: |
        The session events render as structured blocks: agent messages (markdown),
        tool calls (collapsible with icon, input/output, timing), and thinking blocks
        (collapsed by default, expandable)
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        An active session with streaming output
      when: |
        The user views the session
      then: |
        Live text streams in real-time via agent_text_chunk WebSocket events,
        with periodic structured refresh from events.jsonl
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        The session stream view
      when: |
        New content arrives while auto-scrolling
      then: |
        The view auto-scrolls to follow new content, pauses when user scrolls up
        (>100px from bottom), and resumes when scrolled back. A "jump to bottom"
        button appears when paused.
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        The session stream view
      when: |
        A session context panel is shown on the left
      then: |
        It displays session metadata, spec context with AC checklist,
        files changed during session, and budget info

- title: "Agent and Dispatch View"
  slug: ui-agent-dispatch
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    View showing agent definitions, dispatch status (running/stopped),
    and active invocations with links to session streams.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The /agents route
      when: |
        Agent definitions exist in meta
      then: |
        Each agent shows name, triggers, active invocation count, and completed count
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        The dispatch engine is running
      when: |
        The agents page renders
      then: |
        Dispatch status shows as running with a stop button, and active invocations
        show task ref, elapsed time, and link to session stream
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        The dispatch engine is stopped
      when: |
        The agents page renders
      then: |
        Dispatch status shows as stopped with no active invocations

- title: "Session History"
  slug: ui-session-history
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    List view of past agent sessions with filtering and navigation to session detail.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        Sessions exist on disk
      when: |
        The user navigates to /sessions
      then: |
        A list of sessions shows ID, agent type, task ref, status,
        duration, and age, sorted by most recent first
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        The session list
      when: |
        The user clicks a session
      then: |
        They navigate to /sessions/:id showing the session stream view

- title: "Enhanced Inbox View"
  slug: ui-inbox-enhanced
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Enhanced inbox with triage status inline, quick actions, filtering, and bulk selection.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        Inbox items with varying triage states
      when: |
        The inbox view renders
      then: |
        Each item shows triage status inline (untriaged/triaged/acted_on)
        with quick triage action links
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        The inbox view
      when: |
        The user applies filters (status, tags, age)
      then: |
        The list filters accordingly

- title: "Plans View"
  slug: ui-plans-view
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    View for browsing plan records with progress tracking via linked specs and tasks.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        Plan records exist
      when: |
        The user navigates to /plans
      then: |
        Each plan shows title, status, creation date, linked spec/task counts,
        and progress based on task completion status

- title: "Validation and Alignment View"
  slug: ui-validation-view
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    View showing validation results, alignment statistics, and issues.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The user navigates to /validate
      when: |
        Validation data loads
      then: |
        Summary shows error count, warning count, valid item count.
        Alignment section shows spec coverage %, AC coverage %,
        orphaned tasks/specs counts. Issues list grouped by severity.

- title: "Dashboard Overview"
  slug: ui-dashboard-overview
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Home view answering "what's happening right now?" with active work,
    status summary, recent activity, and needs-attention aggregation.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The user navigates to /
      when: |
        The dashboard renders
      then: |
        Active work section shows currently running agent tasks (if any),
        status summary shows clickable count cards per status,
        needs-attention section aggregates untriaged inbox, unresolved observations,
        validation warnings, and blocked tasks
```

    Map oklch color tokens, spacing, radii, z-index, typography, and animation
    keyframes as Tailwind theme extensions. Establish consistent visual language
    across all views.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The web UI app.css file
      when: |
        imgen token-contract.css values are mapped as Tailwind @theme inline extensions
      then: |
        All 16 color tokens, 4 radii, 7 spacing, 7 z-index, and 3 font families
        are available as Tailwind utility classes (e.g. bg-design-surface, border-design-border)
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        A component using design tokens
      when: |
        The dark theme tokens are applied
      then: |
        oklch colors render correctly and status colors (pending=amber, in_progress=orange,
        pending_review=blue, needs_work=yellow, completed=emerald, blocked=red, cancelled=gray)
        are visually distinct
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        A view with loading states
      when: |
        Content is loading
      then: |
        Shimmer animation plays on skeleton elements, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        An active agent task card
      when: |
        The agent is working
      then: |
        Breathing/pulse animation plays on the card border, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion

- title: "App Shell and Navigation"
  slug: ui-app-shell
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Restructure the web UI layout with collapsible sidebar navigation, header bar
    with command palette and connection status, and grouped navigation sections.
    Preserve existing functionality during migration.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        The web UI loaded in daemon mode
      when: |
        The app shell renders
      then: |
        A collapsible sidebar shows grouped navigation: Work (Dashboard, Tasks, Agents, Sessions),
        Specs (Specs, Plans, Validate), Capture (Inbox, Observations, Triage),
        Config (Workflows, Settings)
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        Sidebar navigation items
      when: |
        Items have actionable counts (inbox items, unresolved observations, pending review tasks)
      then: |
        Badge counts display next to the relevant nav items
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        The /items route
      when: |
        A user navigates to /items
      then: |
        They are redirected to /specs preserving any query parameters
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        The Observations nav item
      when: |
        There are zero unresolved observations
      then: |
        The nav item is still visible (not hidden)

- title: "Task Board (Kanban)"
  slug: ui-task-board
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    Kanban-style task board with columns mapping to kspec task states.
    Active Fleet row shows currently running agent work with live output.
    Task cards show key metadata, clicking opens detail modal.
    Not drag-and-drop — tasks transition via agents/CLI.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        Tasks in various states
      when: |
        The task board renders
      then: |
        Tasks are distributed into columns: Backlog (pending, manual_only/unassessed),
        Ready (pending, eligible), In Progress (in_progress, needs_work),
        Review (pending_review), Done (completed recent), with blocked and cancelled
        handled as sections/indicators
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        A task card on the board
      when: |
        The card renders
      then: |
        It shows priority badge, tag chips, title, slug (mono), spec ref link,
        and metadata footer (notes count, dependency count, age)
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        A task card
      when: |
        The user clicks it
      then: |
        A detail modal opens showing full task info: title, description, status,
        priority, type, spec ref, tags, dependencies, blocked-by, notes, todos,
        automation status, VCS info (branch, PR link), plan ref, session link
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        Agents actively working on tasks (dispatch running)
      when: |
        The task board renders
      then: |
        An Active Fleet row appears at the top showing cards with task title,
        agent name, elapsed time with pulse indicator, and last few lines of output
    - id: ac-5
      given: |
        The task board with WebSocket connected
      when: |
        A task state changes
      then: |
        The board updates in real-time without page refresh
    - id: ac-6
      given: |
        The task detail modal in daemon mode
      when: |
        The user clicks action buttons (Start, Submit, Complete, Block, Add Note)
      then: |
        The corresponding task transition or mutation is executed via API

- title: "Session Stream View"
  slug: ui-session-stream
  type: feature
  parent: "@web-ui"
  description: |
    View for watching agent work — both historical and live. Renders structured
    session events (messages, tool calls, thinking blocks) from events.jsonl.
    Live sessions show streaming text with periodic structured refresh.
  acceptance_criteria:
    - id: ac-1
      given: |
        A completed session with events.jsonl
      when: |
        The user navigates to /sessions/:id
      then: |
        The session events render as structured blocks: agent messages (markdown),
        tool calls (collapsible with icon, input/output, timing), and thinking blocks
        (collapsed by default, expandable)
    - id: ac-2
      given: |
        An active session with streaming output
      when: |
        The user views the session
      then: |
        Live text streams in real-time via agent_text_chunk WebSocket events,
        with periodic structured refresh from events.jsonl
    - id: ac-3
      given: |
        The session stream view
      when: |
        New content arrives while auto-scrolling
      then: |
        The view auto-scrolls to follow new content, pauses when user scrolls up

        button appears when paused.
    - id: ac-4
      given: |
        The session stream view
      when: |
        A session context panel is shown on the left
      then: |
        It displays session metadata, spec context with AC checklist,
        files changed during session, and budget info

- title: "Agent and Dispatch View"

    - id: ac-2

      then: |

    - id: ac-3

      when: |

      then: |

- title: "Session History"

    - id: ac-2

- title: "Enhanced Inbox View"

      when: |

    - id: ac-2

- title: "Plans View"
  slug: ui-plans-view
  type: feature

- title: "Validation and Alignment View"
  slug: ui-validation-view

### Implementation Notes

#### ui-design-system
Set up the isolated clone first. Port imgen's full token-contract.css into
Tailwind @theme inline in app.css. Start with the token bridge pilot on the
dashboard page to validate the approach before touching other views. Create
tokens.css, animations.css, typography.css in lib/ds/. Establish loading
skeleton and error boundary patterns.

#### ui-app-shell
Restructure +layout.svelte with new sidebar component. Migrate existing
Sidebar.svelte to grouped navigation. Add /items -> /specs redirect.
Fix Observations nav visibility bug. Migrate taskDetailStore from Svelte 4
to Svelte 5 runes. Consolidate three existing task detail implementations.
Ensure all existing routes still work.

#### ui-task-board
Prerequisite: daemon must return type and automation in task list API response
(quick fix to packages/daemon/src/routes/tasks.ts). Add needs_work to status
color/label maps. Build KanbanBoard, KanbanColumn, TaskCard, TaskDetailModal,
ActiveFleetRow components. Wire to tasks:updates WebSocket topic. Build task
mutation endpoints in daemon (submit, complete, block) for detail modal actions.

#### ui-session-stream
Prerequisite: build GET /api/sessions and GET /api/sessions/:id/events daemon
endpoints. Two-tier rendering: structured events from events.jsonl for history,
agent_text_chunk WS for live text. Build SessionStream, ChatMessage,
ToolCallView, ThinkingBlock components. Implement auto-scroll with pause/resume.
Port patterns from kynetic-internal's ChatPanel.

#### ui-agent-dispatch
Uses existing GET /api/agent/dispatch/status and GET /api/agent/status endpoints.
Subscribe to agents WS topic for real-time updates. Build AgentList,
DispatchStatus, InvocationCard components.

#### ui-session-history
Depends on GET /api/sessions endpoint from ui-session-stream work.
Build SessionList with filtering. Link to session stream view.

#### ui-inbox-enhanced
Enhance existing inbox view. Add triage status from existing triage API.
Add filter controls. Keep existing add/delete functionality.

#### ui-plans-view
Prerequisite: build GET /api/plans daemon endpoint (wrap existing loadAllPlans).
Build PlanList with progress calculation from linked task statuses.

#### ui-validation-view
Uses existing GET /api/validate and GET /api/alignment endpoints.
Build ValidationSummary, AlignmentStats, IssueList components.

#### ui-dashboard-overview
Build last. Uses data from tasks, inbox, observations, validation APIs.
Active work section reuses ActiveFleetRow from task board.
No aggregated activity API needed — merge recent data client-side.

		loadBoard();

	function handleAgentUpdate(event: BroadcastEvent) {

		if (event.event === 'agent_text_chunk' && event.data?.session_id && event.data?.text) {
			const sessionId = event.data.session_id as string;
			const text = event.data.text as string;
			const newLines = text.split('\n').filter((l: string) => l.trim().length > 0);

				const existing = agentOutputLines[sessionId] ?? [];
				agentOutputLines[sessionId] = [...existing, ...newLines].slice(-MAX_OUTPUT_LINES);
			}
			return;
		}

				// Clean up output lines for sessions no longer active
				const activeSessions = new Set(
					status.active_invocations.map((inv) => inv.session_id)

					if (!activeSessions.has(sessionId)) {
						delete agentOutputLines[sessionId];
					}
				}
			})
			.catch(() => {});

Perfect! Now I have all the information I need. Let me compile a comprehensive exploration report. ## Comprehensive Web-UI Codebase Exploration Report Based on my thorough exploration of the kynetic-spec-ui web-ui package, here's the complete picture: ### 1. DIRECTORY STRUCTURE **Core Directories:** - `/src/lib/components/` - Reusable UI components - `board/` - Task board (Kanban) components - `ui/` - Design system components (buttons, badges, dialogs, etc.) - Root components (Sidebar, ProjectSelector, CommandPalette, etc.) - `/src/lib/ds/` - Design system - `tokens.css` - Design tokens (colors, spacing, radii, z-index, fonts) - `animations.css` - Animation keyframes (shimmer, breathe) - `/src/lib/stores/` - Svelte runes state management - `/src/lib/websocket/` - WebSocket connection management - `/src/lib/types/` - TypeScript type definitions - `/src/lib/hooks/` - Svelte hooks (e.g., is-mobile) - `/src/routes/` - SvelteKit page routes **Routes Available:** - `/` - Dashboard (home page) - `/tasks` - Task list view - `/tasks/board` - Kanban board view - `/agents` - Agent status - `/sessions` - Session context - `/specs` - Spec items - `/plans` - Plans - `/validate` - Validation - `/inbox` - Inbox items - `/observations` - Observations - `/triage` - Triage UI - `/workflows` - Workflows - `/settings` - Settings --- ### 2. EXISTING DASHBOARD IMPLEMENTATION **Location:** `/src/routes/+page.svelte` Current dashboard shows **5 task count cards** in a grid: - Ready (pending status, no unmet dependencies) - In Progress (in_progress status) - Pending Review (pending_review status) - Blocked (either blocked status OR pending with unmet dependencies) - Completed (completed status) Each card is clickable and navigates to filtered tasks list. Uses: - `fetchTasks()` API to get all tasks (limit: 1000) - Manual dependency resolution to compute "ready" and "blocked" counts - Project version tracking to reload on project change - Simple loading state with `animate-pulse` **AC Coverage:** @web-dashboard ac-1, ac-2, ac-3 --- ### 3. API CONNECTION PATTERNS **File:** `/src/lib/api.ts` Key patterns: - **Mode-aware dispatch:** Checks `isStaticMode()` and falls back to static data or live API - **Project header injection:** All requests include `X-Kspec-Dir: ` header when project selected - **Error handling:** Detects invalid project errors and clears selection - **Write operation guards:** Uses `assertWritable()` to throw in read-only mode **Main API Functions:** ``` fetchTasks(params?) → PaginatedResponse fetchTask(ref) → TaskDetail fetchAgentStatus() → AgentStatus fetchItems(params?) → PaginatedResponse fetchItem(ref) → ItemDetail startTask(ref) → void submitTask(ref) → void completeTask(ref, reason) → void blockTask(ref, reason) → void addTaskNote(ref, content) → void fetchProjects() → { projects: Project[] } ``` --- ### 4. ACTIVEFLEETROW COMPONENT **File:** `/src/lib/components/board/ActiveFleetRow.svelte` Shows currently running agent invocations: - Only visible when `dispatch_enabled && active_invocations.length > 0` - Displays agent ID, task ref, elapsed time with pulse indicator - Last 3 lines of agent output in monospace font (MAX_OUTPUT_LINES = 3) - Horizontal scrollable row of flex-shrink-0 cards (width: w-72) - Uses breathing animation (`ds-breathe`) on pulse indicator **Props:** - `status: AgentStatus | null` - `outputLines: Record` (keyed by session_id) - `taskTitles: Record` (keyed by task ref) **Emits:** Events from board page lifecycle --- ### 5. DESIGN SYSTEM & TOKENS **File:** `/src/lib/ds/tokens.css` (164 lines) **Colors:** - 16 core tokens (bg, fg, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring) - 7 semantic status colors with light/dark variants: - pending (yellow-like) - in_progress (blue-like) - pending_review (purple) - needs_work (amber) - completed (green) - blocked (red) - cancelled (gray) **Spacing Scale:** - xs (0.25rem), sm (0.5rem), md (1rem), lg (1.5rem), xl (2rem), 2xl (3rem), 3xl (4rem) **Radii:** - sm, md, lg, xl (0.25rem → 0.75rem) **Z-Index Stack:** - base (0), dropdown (10), sticky (20), overlay (30), modal (40), popover (50), toast (60) **Fonts:** - primary/secondary: system UI sans-serif - mono: ui-monospace (Cascadia Code, Source Code Pro, Menlo, Consolas) **Animations:** - `ds-shimmer` (2s, background gradient sweep) - `ds-breathe` (3s, glow + inset shadow pulse) - Both respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` --- ### 6. LOADING SKELETONS & ERROR PATTERNS **BoardSkeleton Component:** `/src/lib/components/board/BoardSkeleton.svelte` - Shows 5 placeholder columns with staggered card counts - Uses `` component with `ds-shimmer` class - Flex layout: `flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto p-6` **Skeleton Component:** `/src/lib/components/ui/skeleton/skeleton.svelte` - Simple div with `bg-accent animate-pulse` - Supports custom classNames **Error Patterns (observed in code):** - Try-catch with `error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to...'` - Error displayed in `{#if error}` conditional blocks - Read-only mode errors use `ReadOnlyModeError` class from mode store - No global error boundary component visible **Loading States:** - Inline `{#if loading}` with `...` - Full page skeleton during initial board load - Partial skeleton for individual cards in lists --- ### 7. SIDEBAR & NAVIGATION **File:** `/src/lib/components/Sidebar.svelte` **Structure:** - 4 navigation groups: Work, Specs, Capture, Config - Badge counts on actionable items (inbox, observations, pending review) - ProjectSelector shown when `hasMultipleProjects()` is true - Fetches session context, inbox count, observations count on load **Used in:** `/src/routes/+layout.svelte` via `` **Route Structure:** - Uses SvelteKit `$page.url` to track current page - Conditional badge visibility based on counts --- ### 8. WEBSOCKET CONNECTION **Manager:** `/src/lib/websocket/manager.ts` (499 lines) **Key Features:** - Exponential backoff reconnection (1s, 2s, 4s... 30s max) - Sequence deduplication (skip seq <= lastSeqProcessed) - Reset lastSeqProcessed = -1 on reconnect - Re-subscribe to all topics on reconnect - Connection lost indicator (after 10s disconnected) - Trigger update handlers on broadcast events **Subscription Pattern:** ```typescript subscribe(['tasks', 'agents']) // Multiple topics on('tasks', (event: BroadcastEvent) => { ... }) ``` **Connection State:** 'disconnected' | 'connecting' | 'connected' | 'reconnecting' **Store Integration:** `/src/lib/stores/connection.svelte.ts` - Global `WebSocketManager` instance - Reactive `connectionState` and `connectionLost` runes - Functions: `initConnection()`, `reconnectWithProject()`, `subscribe()`, `on()`, etc. --- ### 9. PROJECT MANAGEMENT STORE **File:** `/src/lib/stores/project.svelte.ts` **State:** - `projects: Project[]` (registered projects list) - `selectedPath: string | null` (current selection) - `projectVersion: number` (increments on change to trigger reloads) - Persisted to localStorage under `'kspec-selected-project'` **Multi-Project Support:** - `hasMultipleProjects()` → checks `projects.length > 1` - `selectProject(path)` → sets `selectedPath` and increments `projectVersion` - All API requests include `X-Kspec-Dir: ` header **On Project Change:** - Version incremented → triggers `$effect` in consuming components - Components watch `getProjectVersion()` to reload data - WebSocket reconnects with new project via `reconnectWithProject()` --- ### 10. TASK BOARD IMPLEMENTATION (Kanban) **Location:** `/src/routes/tasks/board/+page.svelte` **Key Features:** **Column Distribution:** ```typescript distributeToColumns(tasks) → BoardColumn[] { backlog: pending + (manual_only | unassessed) ready: pending + eligible_automation in_progress: in_progress | needs_work | blocked review: pending_review done: completed (recent 20, sorted by time) } ``` **Real-time Updates:** - Subscribes to `['tasks', 'agents']` topics - On `task_update` event → reload board - On `agent_text_chunk` → accumulate last 3 lines per session - On agent lifecycle events → refresh status and cleanup output **ActiveFleetRow Integration:** - Passes `agentStatus` from `fetchAgentStatus()` - Maintains `agentOutputLines` mapping - Maintains `taskTitles` lookup for display **Task Detail Modal:** - Click task card → opens detail modal with full info - Can start, submit, complete, block, add notes - Modal refreshes task after action --- ### 11. BOARD UTILITIES **File:** `/src/lib/components/board/board-utils.ts` **Key Functions:** ```typescript getStatusClasses(status) → { bg, fg, label } Returns Tailwind class names for status colors distributeToColumns(tasks) → BoardColumn[] Distributes tasks to 5 columns with smart logic formatAge(dateStr) → "5m" | "2h" | "3d" | etc. Relative time formatting formatElapsed(ms) → "2m 30s" | "45s" Elapsed time for active agents formatVcsRef(ref) → { label, url } Parses "branch:name", "pr:123", or URLs Returns display label and optional link ``` --- ### 12. TAILWIND & CSS PATTERNS **Design Token Mapping:** - Status colors map to `--design-status-*` CSS custom properties - Status classes: `bg-status-pending`, `text-status-pending-fg`, etc. - Animation classes: `ds-shimmer`, `ds-breathe` - Skeleton uses `bg-accent animate-pulse` **Common Patterns:** ```svelte
...
``` --- ### 13. KEY COMPONENT PATTERNS **Task Card:** Shows priority (P1/P2/P3), status dot, title, slug, tags, spec ref, metadata (notes count, dependency count, age) **Error Boundary:** No global error boundary exists; errors handled locally with try-catch blocks **Loading States:** - Full page: `` or simple loading message - Inline: `{#if loading} ... {:else} ... {/if}` - Cards: `` **Responsive Design:** - Desktop sidebar: `hidden md:block` - Mobile nav at bottom: `hidden md:hidden` - SidebarInset handles responsive main content - Grid columns adjust with `md:` and `lg:` breakpoints --- ### 14. CONSTANTS **File:** `/src/lib/constants.ts` ```typescript DAEMON_PORT = 3456 DAEMON_API_BASE = getDaemonApiBase() // Same-origin or localhost:3456 DAEMON_WS_BASE = getDaemonWsBase() // ws:// or wss:// ``` --- ### 15. STATIC MODE SUPPORT - `isStaticMode()` check gates live API calls - Falls back to `api-static.ts` for read-only mode (GitHub Pages export) - Write operations throw `ReadOnlyModeError` - Connection store and WebSocket disabled in static mode --- ### SUMMARY FOR DASHBOARD IMPLEMENTATION You now have: 1. **Existing dashboard template** - Simple 5-card grid showing task counts 2. **API layer** - Fully set up with mode support and project headers 3. **WebSocket connection** - Real-time updates available via subscription 4. **Design tokens** - Complete color system with status colors and animations 5. **Loading patterns** - Skeleton components with `ds-shimmer` animation 6. **Board utilities** - Column distribution, formatting, status color mapping 7. **Project management** - Multi-project support with header injection 8. **Error handling** - Pattern of try-catch with user-friendly messages 9. **Navigation** - 4-group sidebar with badge counts 10. **Active fleet indicator** - Ready-to-use component for agent status All code follows Svelte 5 rune patterns, respects accessibility (prefers-reduced-motion), and maintains design consistency through CSS tokens.
